scope: Hand proof over a commutative residue ring for polynomial-description Boolean tensor networks of degree O(s^0.9), including fixed witness bits. No kernel or implementation benchmark.
statement: Unimodular one-bit crossing factors and cubic clique grouping give a deterministic exact Boolean tensor counter in 2^{O(s/(log s)^alpha)} bit time and polynomial space, for alpha=log_3(4/log_2(12)). This yields exact pinned decomposition decision in the same exponent.
